title: Crispy Italian Fritters
description: Crunchy fritters filled with Italian flavors, perfect as a snack or side dish.
instructions: In a bowl, mix together the flour, parmesan, seasonings, and salt.
Add the crushed crispy snack and mix well.
In a separate bowl, beat the egg.
Add the kinako flour to the egg and mix until smooth.
Combine the egg mixture with the flour mixture and mix until a dough forms.
Cover the dough with plastic wrap and let it rest for 30 minutes.
Heat about 2-3 inches (5-7.5 cm) of oil in a deep frying pan over medium-high heat.
Using a cookie scoop or spoon, drop small balls of dough into the hot oil.
Fry the fritters for 2-3 minutes on each side, or until golden brown.
Remove the fritters from the oil with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels.
